description.fun: Each Yamask was once a person, a spirit from a grave of a bygone age, and it carries a mask of the face it had in life. Sometimes it gazes at the mask and weeps, and it wanders ruins at night searching for someone who knows its face; it grows furious if the mask is taken. Its Japanese name, Desumasu, puns on 'death mask' and the polite Japanese desu and masu endings.
description.guide: Yamask is a Ghost-type Pokémon said to arise from the spirits of people buried long ago, carrying a mask of its former face. It evolves into Cofagrigus. In Galar it has a Ground- and Ghost-type form that evolves into Runerigus instead.
description.tagline: A weeping spirit that carries the face it had in life.

description.fun: A cursed clay slab with ancient engravings took hold of this Yamask's vengeful spirit, and the slab is said to soak up its dark power. It swings the tablet around with malicious intent, and the curse is what lets it become Runerigus.

Cofagrigus looks like a gleaming gold coffin and uses that to teach grave robbers a lesson: anyone who mistakes it for treasure and gets too close is trapped inside its body and, legend says, turned into a mummy. It snacks on gold nuggets and waits in tombs and ruins. Unlike Yamask, it no longer remembers being human. Its design seems to draw on Tutankhamun's coffins and mask.
description.guide: Cofagrigus is the evolved form of Yamask, a Ghost-type Pokémon resembling a golden Egyptian sarcophagus with shadowy arms. It lives in tombs and is said to trap grave robbers and turn them into mummies.
description.tagline: A golden sarcophagus that traps grave robbers.

description.fun: Runerigus is an ancient painting woven with a powerful curse, which began to move after it absorbed the spirit of a Galarian Yamask. Never touch its shadowy body, or you'll be shown the horrifying memories behind the picture carved into it. Now that the scattered pieces of its clay slab are back together, its malicious power is fully unleashed. It may be based on Viking runestones, some carved with curses on anyone who moved them.
description.guide: Runerigus is a Ground- and Ghost-type Pokémon, a cursed clay painting brought to life. It evolves only from Galarian Yamask and is Galar's counterpart to Cofagrigus.
description.tagline: A cursed rune slab brought to life by a Yamask's spirit.

transitions.how: Take 49 damage, then pass under the stone arch, at Dusty Bowl

note.text: Only Galarian Yamask becomes Runerigus: after taking at least 49 points of damage in one battle without fainting, it must pass under the stone arch at Dusty Bowl in Galar's Wild Area. The 49 may nod to the 49 days a soul spends between death and rebirth in Buddhist belief.
